system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Hierarchical system prompt structure with XML-based formatting for Claude, improved LLM attention management
system_prompt_style.note: Guardrail section injected only when permission engine active; per-agent system_message configurable.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: MassGen agents can **autonomously read, write, modify, and delete files** within their permitted directories.
env_context_strategy.note: Context paths shared, agents explore via filesystem/MCP tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Automatic conversation compression when context length errors occur, streaming buffer system tracking partial responses for recovery
context_compaction.note: Reactive compression is the shipped default; pruning inferred from compression/buffer handling.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Browser automation with screenshots and reporting

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: CodeAct paradigm implementation with tool integration via importable Python code reducing token usage by 98%
tool_call_format.note: Default is provider native tool calling ('OpenAI-style tool calling'); code-based tools opt-in.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: **Claude Code**: Built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Bash, Grep, Glob, LS, TodoWrite)
edit_primitive.note: Edit/MultiEdit are search-replace; Write is whole-file. Other backends use MCP filesystem server.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: **Custom Tools**: Define your own tools via YAML configuration
tool_schema_source.note: MCP tools are auto-discovered from servers.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: **MCP Integration**: Connect to any MCP server for extended capabilities
protocol_standardization.note: NLIP (Natural Language Interface Protocol) also mentioned in v0.1.13.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Every agent tackles the full problem, observing, critiquing, and building on each other's work across cycles of refinement and restarts.
loop_primitives.note: multi_attempt (parallel agents + voting) is the default; plan_execute via --plan-and-execute.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: plan storage system in `.massgen/plans/` with frozen snapshots and execution tracking
planning_granularity.note: Planning mode is opt-in via --plan; task planning MCP server tracks task lifecycle.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agents continuously share their working summaries and insights through a notification system
multi_agent_topology.note: Orchestrator distributes the same task to all agents who vote; subagent spawning also available.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn parallel child MassGen processes with isolated workspaces and automatic result aggregation
delegation_mechanism.note: Default multi-agent coordination is via shared notification hub; subagents opt-in.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: An `ask` resolves via an automation **policy** (`risk-based` / `deny-all` / `allow-all`) or a **file** request/response handshake
human_in_loop.note: Permission engine is opt-in; also human broadcast Q&A and mid-stream steering.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Complete session state tracking and restoration with SessionState dataclass and SessionRegistry for multi-turn persistence

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term semantic memory via mem0 integration with fact extraction and retrieval across sessions
long_term_memory.note: Memory MCP uses markdown storage; Qdrant vector DB; skills system loads skill library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Ctrl+C saves partial progress during coordination, cancelled sessions resume with `--continue` preserving agent answers and workspaces

self_verification.evidence_quote: Winning agents evaluate their own answers before submission with submit and restart capabilities
self_verification.note: Round evaluator / critic subagents and checklist voting add llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: When agents believe there is a strong enough answer, they vote, and the best collectively validated answer wins.
retry_policy.note: Refinement rounds continue until consensus; orchestrator timeout bounds the run.

rollback.evidence_quote: workspace snapshots and restoration, enhanced path permission system with smart exclusions

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Orchestrator-level timeout with graceful fallback and enhanced error messages
termination_condition.note: Consensus/vote ends the run (model_declared); RoundBudgetGuardHook gives per-round cost control; timeout is F3.

cost_controls.note: Codex prompt caching fix (v0.1.60); circuit breaker multi-region failover is closest to routing.

timeouts.note: Orchestrator-level timeout gives per_run; tool/background execution timeouts give per_tool.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Container-based isolation with secure command execution in isolated Docker containers preventing host filesystem access
execution_isolation.note: Docker and srt OS sandbox are configurable modes; local execution appears to be the base mode.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: **Isolated Workspaces**: Each agent's `cwd` is fully isolated and writable
filesystem_access.note: Context paths read-only during coordination; protected_paths immune from modification.

network_policy.evidence_quote: network isolation modes, and read-only volume mounts
network_policy.note: Network isolation/deny-all is opt-in via Docker or srt sandbox; default unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: declarative **`allow/ask/deny` rules** over a small `action(target)` algebra (deny-wins), and a **blast-radius risk classifier**
permission_model.note: Opt-in `permissions:` block; a config with no permissions block is unchanged, i.e. default is none.

tracing.evidence_quote: Optional Logfire integration with automatic LLM instrumentation for OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini backends
tracing.note: Default on: structured coordination_events.json and logs.

replayability.evidence_quote: Original query, timestamp, configuration, and execution context for reproducibility

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Automated VHS recording with AI-powered terminal display evaluation
eval_hooks.note: No standard benchmark runner found in evidence; evaluation here is criteria/checklist evaluation of answers.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a non-overridable **hardline** blocklist (`hardline.py`: `rm -rf /`, fork bombs, raw-disk `dd`)
guardrails.note: Binary file protection blocks text tools on 40+ binary types; DSPy paraphrasing rewrites input; action_policies is the primary one.

target_domain.evidence_quote: autonomously orchestrating frontier models and agents to collaborate, reason, and produce high-quality results
target_domain.note: General-purpose; ships coding, browser automation, MCP, research configs.

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: **OpenRouter**: Multi-model aggregator with dynamic model listing (400+ models)

first_release_date.note: Earliest version referenced in evidence is v0.0.3 (Foundation Architecture) but no date given.
